errors.evidence: The green line representing rural areas starts at 2.5% in 2013, not 0.5%.
The green line representing rural areas ends at approximately 4.9% in 2022, not 3.2%.
The blue line is dashed ('gestrichelt'), not solid ('durchgezogene').

errors.text_span: wobei der Wert bei 2,1 % im Jahr 2013 beginnt und bei 4,1 % im Jahr 2022 endet
errors.evidence: The blue line starts at exactly 2.0% in 2013 and ends at exactly 4.0% in 2022. The reported values of 2.1% and 4.1% are slightly inaccurate.
The line representing the difference is black, not grey.

errors.text_span: beginnt bei -1,6 % im Jahr 2013 und endet bei 0,1 % im Jahr 2022
errors.evidence: The line representing the difference starts at 0.5% in 2013 and ends at approximately 0.8% in 2022. The reported values are completely incorrect and outside the plausible range shown in the chart.

errors.text_span: Für jedes Datenpunktpaar sind schwarze Fehlerbalken dargestellt, die sich über die y-Achse erstrecken, beginnend bei 0,2 % im Jahr 2013 und endend bei 0,6 % im Jahr 2022.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors. The error bars are only on the black line (the difference), not on 'every data point pair'. Furthermore, it fundamentally misinterprets what error bars are, describing their size/position as if they were a data series with start and end values.
